A.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS ts, max(value) - min(value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE metric_name IN ('otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans', 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total', 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records', 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total', 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points', 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total') AND unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} AND unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
